note: _invenit Tobiam descumbentem: et exsiliens_ [salutavit eum], _osculati sunt se invicem_ (Clementina) – he found Tobias as he was reclining (at the table), and he leaped up [and greeted him], and they kissed each other. The words in square brackets are not in the text; they are added by Reusch on the assumption that they must have dropped out and must be restored. – Franz Heinrich Reusch: _Das Buch Tobias, übersetzt und erklärt_. Freiburg 1857 (l, 144 pp.), p. 97, note 2.
